usage.summary:
Implemented #648’s comparisons, immutable baselines, provenance persistence, annotated rendering, dashboard recovery and documentation.

Run 5 passed all 12 acceptance tests, formatting and vet. Full validation remains blocked by `TestPythonApplicationModuleDeadlineStartsWithItsWatchdog`, which failed in all five runs; its test and runner are outside this plan’s scope.

One implementation choice: project writing fills omitted ratification proposal hashes from the written statements and bounds, preserving explicit hashes.

The merger still needs to record the comparison/baseline policy decision and run pinned-TLC coverage and required real Python/TLAPS CI.
